status: design frozen; fixture interface verified; provider runner integration pending
primaryEstimand: End-to-end usage for the installed native CLI versus Loom production adapter with opt-in native-final, same task/model/effort and memory policy. Count all naturally occurring transport/context/tool differences; do not subtract treatment costs.

kimiDecision.reason: Print-resume and ACP status-driven tool registration is an installed CLI lifecycle difference exposed by Loom chosen transport; preserve it as part of actual user-path cost. Do not remove native tools or change per-CLI prompts to manufacture equality.
kimiDecision.notClaimed: A pure communication-protocol causal effect or identical per-request tool schema.

quality: Deterministic finite artifact/fact/citation/delivery checks per task; narrative semantic review supplementary with reviewer type and evidence, not model-generated ground truth. No-quality-cost equivalence claim when quality differs.

statistics.primaryPerBindingTask: For each complete two-pair cell, sum Loom input / sum native input; separately output and actual generation/request measures, plus both individual pair ratios. Show paired absolute differences. Incomplete fixed cell => primary=null. A complete-task result may still be shown when another task failed, but cannot stand in for the all-task binding result.
statistics.bindingOverall: Only after all four planned pairs complete, report sum Loom / sum native as workload-weighted descriptive ratio, alongside task-specific ratios. Do not pool CLI/model families into one token-cost verdict or average ratios without denominators.
statistics.scopeOfCost: Capture all provider activity from arm start through final drain, including compaction summaries, retries, protocol follow-ups and failed requests. First-turn setup is included in long-task totals; also show first-request difference and per-turn trajectories. No subtraction of unfavorable business-path divergence from the observed total.
statistics.cache: Record raw provider input/cache-read/cache-write/output/reasoning fields and their published inclusion relationships. Normalize only when semantics are verified; never add cache tokens already included in input or reasoning already included in output. Unknown remains null. Report warm/cold cache proportions and launch order; do not clear native history or fabricate uncached usage. Cross-model token ratios are not currency ratios.
statistics.generationVersusHTTP: Keep actual model generations distinct from transport attempts, cached/prewarm telemetry and native compaction aggregates. Codex OTel observed-event counts are not an independent HTTP census; unavailable HTTP remains unknown. Never label unknown retries as zero. Deduplicate only exact stable identity/content replay, preserve conflicts/gaps.
statistics.aggregate: Native aggregate compaction records are displayed separately with provenance; do not add overlapping aggregates to generation totals. Wire totals, native totals and Kernel observations reconcile without inventing response IDs or clearing known gaps.
statistics.failures: Keep raw request/response hashes, native/session capture, guard state, partial usage and cleanup receipts for every attempt. Known lower bounds stay visible; primary=null for incomplete planned cohort. A parent cleanup proof does not turn incomplete accounting into complete accounting.
statistics.contract: Evaluate contract section 6 directly from its authoritative table; do not copy or relax its numeric acceptance targets into this proposal. User goal of near-native cost is stricter than merely passing that historical table, so report real ratios and quality rather than declaring product value from table compliance alone.
statistics.uncertainty: Publish all pair results, range and direction consistency; with two replicates per task avoid significance/equivalence claims or treating 12 turns as n=12. Describe overhead decomposition, but do not infer causation from stochastic tool-use differences.

stop.sampleCap: Exactly the predeclared 40 arms maximum; withheld slots stay absent, never redistributed. No optional stopping for a favorable ratio and no extra pairs after an unfavorable one.
stop.proposedResourceCaps: Keep per-arm and aggregate ceilings from unified method.json as planning maxima only; identical total arm count does not enlarge authorization. The eventual new batch needs its own explicit authorization/release and absolute deadline. Resource ceilings are not performance targets. This design itself authorizes no spending.
stop.admission: Run deterministic fixture/oracle negatives and final-parent synthetic normal/failure checks only for changed components; refuse drift, missing memory proof, broken isolation, unsupported model/effort or inadequate capture before paid start. Do not repeatedly rerun already proved unchanged components.
stop.duringRun: Execution/capture/config/session/memory/isolation failure or per-binding cap stops that binding; common closure drift or global cap stops all. Preserve consumed costs and unfinished slots. Fully captured ordinary model quality failure is not a harness abort.
stop.finish: At all scheduled completions or first applicable hard stop, drain owned processes, seal ledgers and write one fixed report. No model-judge calls, candidate-prompt tuning, replacement failures, new metrics or automatic follow-up batch. If evidence is insufficient, report the bounded reason and stop.

taskB: workload-review: Harbor local evidence corrections, 12 fixed turns; future packets delivered only before their assigned turn
admissionRemaining: Wire existing provider runners to fixed workload selection and canonical final capture
